explication: imsg is a macOS CLI and stdio API for reading and monitoring local Messages history, sending messages, and accessing advanced Messages.app features through an optional injected bridge. The main workflow starts at the CLI or JSON-RPC boundary, resolves targets and parameters, then reads the local database or dispatches a send/bridge action; results are emitted as JSON lines or RPC responses. README capabilities also include chat management, search, statistics, reactions, polls, stickers, scheduled messages, and typing. Unexcerpted feature branches are retained only where their paths are supported; dashed links mark documented but unsampled routing.
